founderAuthorization.rule: Founder rule 2026-09-29: A blocked/review-pending package blocks ONLY its own dependency lane; implement the next independent eligible package in an isolated branch, validate, checkpoint, commit, prepare the frozen review bundle, mark it REVIEW_PENDING if Codex is unavailable, and continue; never modify a pending package's branch, bundle, clone, evidence or cycle state.
founderAuthorization.constraint: Tests and non-protected documentation only; no protected file, no pending package scope, no merge.

rationale: The PowerShell installer scripts only run at install time; the first Phase0 attempt showed install-time-only defects are expensive. This package checks every script with the real PowerShell 5.1 parser and safety rules and cross-checks the two install-time artifact verifiers.

F-T4-001.observed: The PowerShell verifier checks listed entries, hashes, reparse points and lockfile membership but not unlisted extra files; the Node verifier rejects them. install.ps1 runs the PowerShell verifier, then the optional install-prereqs.ps1 (-InstallPrereqs), then the Node verifier, all before bootstrap.
F-T4-001.impact: low: only listed and hash-verified scripts run before the Node verifier; an unlisted file is caught before bootstrap
F-T4-001.disposition: FOUNDER_DECISION_PENDING (protected file) as queue item V6-PKG-L2-PS-VERIFIER-UNLISTED-FILES

F-T4-REVIEW-001.observed: the web-request rule used src.includes on the whole file, so one guarded request satisfied the rule for every other request in an allowlisted script.
F-T4-REVIEW-001.fix: webRequestViolations checks every Invoke-WebRequest/Invoke-RestMethod/iwr/irm invocation on its own command text (line continuations joined, up to the first |, ;, } or line end); each invocation in an allowlisted script must carry the required option.
F-T4-REVIEW-001.retest: web-request-rule-checks-every-invocation: the real ensure-omniroute.ps1 passes; with the first -MaximumRedirection 0 removed (the reviewer's reproduction) exactly one violation is reported; a mixed guarded/unguarded script fails, a line-continued guarded request passes, a guarded request outside the allowlist fails. Reverting to the file-wide check makes this scenario fail.

F-T4-REVIEW-002.observed: runPs and runNode collapsed every result other than exit 0 into false, so a spawn error, timeout or signal satisfied the negative (tamper rejected) assertions.
F-T4-REVIEW-002.fix: verdict() interprets a verifier result only after a real execution: a spawn error, a signal or a non-integer status fails the test; only an integer non-zero exit counts as rejection. Both verifiers must report the expected verdict.
F-T4-REVIEW-002.retest: verifier-results-require-a-real-execution: timeout (null status with ETIMEDOUT), signal, null status and spawn error all throw; exit 1 is REJECT and exit 0 is ACCEPT; the differential scenario uses the verdicts. Reverting verdict() to the collapsed form makes this scenario fail.

remediation.mutationCheck: file-wide web-request check -> web-request-rule-checks-every-invocation FAIL; collapsed verifier result -> verifier-results-require-a-real-execution FAIL; with both fixes 5/5
